title: Rpickup
wikitext: :''For the IRC eggdrop, see [[Rpickup (IRC bot)]].'' An '''rpickup''' is a teamgame in which teams are randomly selected by the server. On modern QuakeWorld servers, one can type /rpickup to vote for random teams. There is also a command for manually selecting team members, namely [[pickup]]. ===Trivia=== Rpickup is notorious for picking the same teams repeatedly, which usually turn out to be the most unbalanced as well. {{terminology}}
